plugins.name: lateral-prompts
plugins.description: A deck of lateral-thinking prompts for breaking stuck thinking. Ships two manually-invoked skills: /lateral-prompts draws 4 cards and fans out 4 isolated subagents, then synthesizes the results; /draw-1 draws a single card (canonical or ephemeral, chosen by code) and runs one explorer for a quick nudge.
